# Louigie Caminoy

> Multidisciplinary technopreneur and AI Engineer based in Metro Manila, Philippines, with a strong interest in AI and Blockchain. Co-founder & CTO of iSkolar, AI Lead of AWS Learning Club - Heron, and BS Computer Science student at the University of Makati.

Bionote: Louigie Caminoy is a multidisciplinary technopreneur and AI Engineer with a strong interest in AI and Blockchain. As Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer of iSkolar, he oversees product development and technical strategy. He gained industry experience at Tutorials Dojo, contributing to mobile applications that reached #1 on the App Store, and serves as AI Lead of AWS Learning Club - Heron. He believes the future belongs to those who build it.

Key facts:

- Currently Co-founder & CTO at iSkolar (scholarship application and management platform, blockchain + AI).
- Also Project Manager & UI/UX Designer at Academy, and AI Lead at AWS Learning Club - Heron.
- Software Engineer Intern at Tutorials Dojo (May-Aug 2026): co-developed Finsharc (#1 AU App Store) and Inki (#1 PH, #5 AU).
- Recognitions: TikTok Shop Regional Case Challenge 2026 Champion, Stellar PH100 2026 Honoree, InfoTechnOlympics 2026 Champion, PCCI Makati Asenso 360 MSME Day Champion, IT Skills Olympics 2nd Runner-Up, DOST Spark-A-Change Challenge 2.0 Top 12 Finalist, Project RISE Top 10 Finalist, 7th CCIS Hackathon 1st Runner-Up.
- Certifications: DataCamp AI Engineer for Developers Associate, Certiport IT Specialist - Databases, Bitget Blockchain4Youth, Quantum Computing and Blockchain Lecture Series 2025.
- Studying BS Computer Science at University of Makati (expected 2027).
- Focus areas: AI engineering, blockchain development, systems architecture, technical leadership, system design, project management, full stack development.
- Contact: louigiecaminoy@gmail.com

## Recognitions

Newest first. Full details: https://www.louigiecaminoy.com/recognitions

- Champion, TikTok Shop Regional Case Challenge 2026 (TikTok Shop; ByteDance Office, BGC Taguig; November 2026). Presented Kapitbahay Hub Lite, a sari-sari store pickup and prepayment model that cuts failed Cash on Delivery orders, as part of a 4-member team and won the Philippine leg of the case challenge.
- Honoree, Stellar PH100 2026 (StellarPH; McKinley Hill; November 2026). Named among the Philippines' Top 100 brightest young minds under 30 for startup contributions.
- 2nd Runner-Up, IT Skills Olympics (University of Makati; November 2026). Presented Animo against 20+ Philippine universities.
- Champion, InfoTechnOlympics 2026 (UMak College of Computing and Information Sciences; University of Makati; October 2026). Presented Animo, a palay marketplace and advisory app focused on efficiency and transparency, and won against 15 participating teams.
- Champion, PCCI - Makati Asenso 360 MSME Day (PCCI Makati; University of Makati; July 2026). Presented iSkolar, a scholarship platform focused on efficiency and transparency, as part of a 3-member team and won against 10 participating teams.
- Top 12 Finalist, DOST Spark-A-Change Challenge 2.0 (DOST; Gateway Mall; June 2026). Presented iSkolar as part of a 5-member team, placing in the Top 12 of 25 teams.
- Top 10 Finalist, Project RISE (University of Makati; Makati Diamond Residences; April 2026). Presented iSkolar and was selected as one of the Top 10 teams from 50 participants.
- 1st Runner-Up and Most Disruptive Innovation, 7th CCIS Hackathon (UMak CCIS; University of Makati; May 2025). Presented Faculty Repository System, a file storage system addressing privacy and file organization using blockchain technology.

## Projects

Full details: https://www.louigiecaminoy.com/projects

- [iSkolar](https://iskolar.io): connects students with scholarship providers and simplifies applications.
- [Academy](https://academy.iskolar.io/): where students showcase projects and theses, and find grants and investors.
- [Vocation](https://vocation.iskolar.io): internships and OJT listings for Filipino students, with 1-on-1 career coaching.
- [Configains](https://configains.fundrstudio.com/): fitness coaching with practical training, flexible nutrition, and personal guidance.
- [Fundr Studio](https://fundrstudio.com/): a software studio taking products from design to release.
- [USMO](https://connect.usmo.org.ph): landing page for the UMak Student Multimedia Organization.
